# Outreach scaffold — copy to paper/outreach/<venue>/<slug>.qmd (created by /write outreach).
# Render: quarto render paper/outreach/<venue>/<slug>.qmd
title: "[Headline]"
subtitle: ""
# Structured array: REPLACES the _quarto.yml author list (a scalar would be appended to it).
author:
  - name: "[Author Name]"
    email: "[email]"
# Keep exactly one format, chosen with the user when the piece is created:
format:
  docx:
    number-sections: false
  # pdf:
  #   number-sections: false
  #   include-in-header: ../../preambles/outreach/outreach-header.tex   # single spacing
  # html:
  #   number-sections: false
  # gfm: default                     # Markdown for blogs/newsletters that take plain text
abstract: ""          # outreach pieces have no abstract; keep empty so _quarto.yml's is not inherited
bibliography: ""      # link sources in the text instead of citing
---
